subject: integration
name: Orivon AI agent
summary: The assistant panel and its loop run as pinned code in a sealed session with no network of its own. It asks the AI model the person connects (hosted, a plan sign-in, or on their computer) and uses only the codes the person allowed: read a web page, look up or point a name (confirmed in the browser's own sheet), keep or publish files. Builds run offline in WebAssembly. Nothing checks the model's answers, and a hosted model sees what the person writes and what its tools read. Level 3, not 4: it relies on a party that can be wrong or stop. Judged here by its publisher.
